code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    if any(len(set(row)) == 1 for row in grid):
        sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
        top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep+1:]
        n = min(len(top), len(bottom))
        common = set(sum(top, [])) & set(sum(bottom, []))
        color = next(iter(common))
        return [[3 if top[r][c] == color and bottom[r][c] == color else color for c in range(w)] for r in range(n)]
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1)
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep+1:] for row in grid]
    n = min(sep, w-sep-1)
    common = set(sum(left, [])) & set(sum(right, []))
    color = next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == color and right[r][c] == color else color for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
'''
